chapter: Boston childhood, learning music and first gigs
title: Hodges bringing New York ideas home
summary: Hodges returned from New York playing advanced ideas; they never talked music directly.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: Well, Johnny had been coming down to New York and going back and forth.
Oh yeah, he had coming back and forth.
So you must have picked up things from him. He must have given you some excitement about playing there.
Well, no, we didn't talk about no music when we talked. You know what I mean? We weren't discussing music. But he would come back... When he'd get

to playing, he would play all these different ideas and things. Oh yeah, he would... And I'd wonder where the hell he got them from. You know, how could he be so advanced? And he get up there and play, and say, "That's what they're playing in New York."
Well, then you and Harry Carney...
We never discussed music. Very seldom.
But you must have decided to come to New York, because you came together.
